title: Ethical Sourcing Executive - Kolkata, India
description:
**Application Deadline:** 
 24 March 2023
 



**Department:** 
 Social Impact \& Sustainability
 



**Location:** 
 India
 



**Compensation:** 
 Rs1,000,000 \- Rs1,200,000 / year
   

  




**Description**
*Great People Work Here*
 Are you searching for a career with bags of variety, in an environment that celebrates differences and empowers collaboration, which values individuals and will encourage you to make an impact? Do you want the freedom to explore, and the opportunities to find new ways and to innovate? If so, TwiningsOvo delivers.
   

  

 We’re looking for people who don’t just come here to get the job done, but who have a real passion for the brand and a desire to do the best job they can. In return, we offer an inspiring package of employee benefits \- to show just how much we value you. This role will offer you the scope for growth and the tools to aim high.
   

  

 The Ethical Sourcing Executive is part of the Global Social Impact and Sustainability team and will provide support to the Senior Social Impact Manager (based Kolkata) in assessing and driving improvements of working and living conditions for communities in Twinings’ agricultural supply chain, primarily tea in the region (India, Sri Lanka, and Indonesia).
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Twinings ambitious Sourced with Care programme and drive tangible, positive and sustainable impact in its supply chain in the region. The role focuses on issues above and beyond the ones traditionally covered by social audits and have a specific focus on by assessing conditions, driving improvements, and supporting the day\-to\-day implementation of tailored projects to improve the quality of life in sourcing communities, including gender, living conditions, livelihoods, health, and nutrition.
   

  

 This opportunity would fit an ambitious and driven candidate with technical expertise looking to develop their ability to influence key stakeholders in the supply chain and broaden their knowledge of ethical and responsible supply chain. If you have the experience and drive to develop within ethical sourcing management, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring and improvements** 
* Organise and conduct needs assessments in sourcing communities in the region against the social criteria defined in the assessment tools (TCNA) by engaging with local communities and relevant stakeholders to identify their needs, priorities in a participatory manner.
* Prepare detailed assessment reports, including scoring and substantiated with evidence to provide clear information to Twinings and producers.
* Identify all key potential social and environmental impacts and risks existing in the system and ensure that their magnitude and significance are understood by the internal stakeholders. Work with Twinings Senior Social Impact Manager and producer groups to agree improvement plan and next actions and keep the internal stakeholders updated.
* Follow up on the progress of suppliers’ improvements against the action plan in a timely manner.
* Build supply chain knowledge in the region (eg: mapping smallholders).


**Projects** 
* Support the day\-to\-day implementation and monitoring of projects in the region.
* Identify needs and support the development and rollout of training/support programme for sites/producers.
* Support global projects or advise on issues across the supply chain (for example on GBV, health and wellbeing, carbon footprint etc.).


**Stakeholders’ engagement** 
* Work with the Senior SI Manager to develop networks with key stakeholders inside and outside the industry and engage in constructive dialogue, to progress the SI\&S agenda and drive change in our supply chain.
* Participating, as required, in relevant industry bodies, acting as Twinings representative.
* Keep up to date on current industry SI\&S initiatives and best practices.


**Communication and reporting / M\&E** 
* Working with partners and producers to track Sourced with Care KPIs in a timely, effective, and accurate manner, and help measure our impact (including financial resilience and women’s empowerment).
* Reporting on sites ethical performances to internal stakeholders (Head of Social Impact, Senior leadership, buyers)
* Contribute to good quality content gathering and comms activities (case studies, pictures, videos, articles, etc.)
* Effective use of the Twinings Ethical database and other tools to track and analyse records of conditions on tea estates and agreed KPIs.
* Provide additional support as needed for reporting activities.


**Team support** 
* Support with general administrative tasks as well as team systems and processes.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, as needed (internal presentation, newsletter article, employees field visit, etc).


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
* A passion for engaging with local communities and driving social change in the agriculture supply chain.
* Previous experience of conducting Community\-based participatory research or needs assessments
* Strong communication skills – verbal and written (fluent in English) including strong presentation skills.
* Ability to establish and manage effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Understanding of human rights, labour rights, UN SDGs, gender issues and ethical sourcing.
* Ability to travel up to 60% of the time (domestic and international), sometimes with basic facilities.
* Up to date knowledge and good command of MS Office (word, excel and power point are must)
* Degree level in the social or development studies, environment, agriculture or in relevant discipline.
* Enthusiastic individual, able to work autonomously as well as being a team player.
* Resourceful and solution\-orientated mind\-set.
* Ability to work independently, work under pressure and to be able to organise own work schedule
* Some Knowledge of the agriculture supply chain and issues related to responsible sourcing in any of the countries in the region.
* At least 2 years’ intensive experience in the relevant fields.
* Sound understanding of ethical issues related to the supply chain, practices and regulations in Sri Lanka, Indonesia and/or India context.
* Knowledge of other languages: Tamil, Bahasa Indonesia, or Hindi.
* Prior experience in human rights, development sector, climate, or sustainability.
* Demonstrate pro\-activeness, an enquiring mind and encourages new ideas.
* Demonstrate teamwork capabilities including in cross functional and international teams.

* Act as a key point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders across multiple geographies

 \#KGS

**Required Experience**

* Proven experience handling cross\-border stakeholders and global projects
* Strong understanding of global TP regulations, OECD transfer pricing guidelines, and country\-specific rules


**Technical Skills \& Knowledge**

+ Intercompany loans and guarantees

 \#KGS

* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.

* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).

title: Senior Associate
description:
**Senior Associate, Accounting Transformation** 




**Role Summary** 




 The Accounting Transformation team partners with clients to improve, remediate, and modernize their accounting operations. As a Senior Associate, you will assess accounting processes, financial data, and reporting practices to identify risks, compliance gaps, and operational inefficiencies. You will lead accounting remediation initiatives, including financial statement clean\-up, account reconciliations, GAAP adjustments, close process documentation, and implementation of scalable accounting practices.
 



 This is a project\-based individual contributor role focused on transforming accounting functions and delivering sustainable outcomes. Success is measured by the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the accounting records, reconciliations, and close processes you leave behind.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Accounting Assessment \& Analysis** 



* Evaluate accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices for compliance with US GAAP.
* Review transaction cycles, including revenue, procure\-to\-pay, payroll, and month\-end close processes.
* Identify accounting risks, reporting issues, control gaps, and operational inefficiencies.
* Assess the quality of the general ledger, chart of accounts, and underlying financial data.
* Document findings and develop remediation plans to address identified issues.



**Accounting Remediation \& Transformation** 



* Perform accounting clean\-up initiatives, including historical corrections, opening balance sheet reconstruction, and cash\-to\-accrual conversions.
* Prepare and post adjusting journal entries supported by appropriate calculations and documentation.
* Apply US GAAP guidance across key accounting areas, including revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and equity.
* Rebuild or optimize chart of accounts structures and support financial data remediation efforts.
* Research accounting issues and prepare supporting analysis and documentation.



**Reconciliations \& Close Process Development** 



* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding reconciling items.
* Develop and document month\-end close procedures, workflows, and control activities.
* Create workpapers, reconciliation templates, supporting schedules, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Establish repeatable and scalable close processes that can be maintained by ongoing accounting teams.
* Transition completed engagements to Exbo's Controllership team through comprehensive documentation and knowledge transfer.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 3 \+ years of accounting experience in public accounting, controllership, accounting operations, or financial reporting.
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting research methodologies.
* Experience managing full\-cycle month\-end close activities and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and posting adjusting journal entries.
* Advanced Excel skills, including large data analysis, pivot tables, lookup functions, and Power Query.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to create clear process documentation.
* High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, audit\-ready work.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects with limited supervision.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience assessing and redesigning accounting processes and controls.
* Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks Online.
* Experience with accounting clean\-ups, first\-audit readiness projects, or finance transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting US\-based clients and working within US GAAP reporting environments.
* Experience with venture\-backed, private equity\-backed, or high\-growth companies.



**Success in This Role** 



* Deliver accurate, reconciled, and GAAP\-compliant financial records.
* Create sustainable accounting processes and audit\-ready documentation.
* Independently manage engagements from assessment through transition.
* Enable ongoing accounting teams to execute a repeatable and well\-documented close process with confidence.

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Manager, Wholesale Credit Risk Analytics**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Decision Sciences job family is structured to address business problems with quantitative solutions like building of predictive algorithms / forecasting / scenario simulations etc. Members of this Job Family are differentiated by their capability of converting a business problem into a quantitative construct, solve it with available statistical / mathematical methods (following the right rigour), engage with IT to implement and finally interpret the model outcomes in business language. The range of business problems may cover areas of business growth, improving customer experience, limiting risk exposure, capital quantification, enhancing internal business processes etc. They are required to, as necessary, embed agile \& exploratory practices into their approach, justify the choice of appropriate methods to various internal and external reviewers. This talent group is expected to keep themselves apprised of latest developments and industry practices around emerging methodologies, techniques etc. and bring those in\-house by applying them for better outcomes.
* Apply relevant analytical methods / algorithms to get actionable insights from HSBC's internal (both structured and unstructured) and external data sources
* Partner with IT / Data Engineering teams to create deployment roadmap
* Independently manage delivery of analytics projects by working with business partners across regions / geographies
* This role will be responsible for supporting Central Model Monitoring in the following capacities:
* Perform Model monitoring activities related to IRB models for all Wholesale portfolios across the Globe.
* The individual is also required to work on key projects within Model Monitoring function and drive changes as on when required.
* You would need to Interact with senior stakeholders across Wholesale Risk.

* The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* At least 5 Years of relevant work experience of using statistical concepts and (or) machine learning models to solve complex business problems. Preferably, at least 3 years of work experience related to Credit Risk in Financial domain
* At least master’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Management or other quantitative fields of study
* Proficiency in Python and Gen AI tools are desired
* Business problem solving skills is essential
* Strong business acumen with out\-of\-the box thinking to drive improved business performance
* Strong stakeholder management skills and seamless delivery of analytics initiatives across markets
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to develop and effectively communicate complex concepts and ideas

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mind \& Matter India is an integrated digital solutions company with a global presence across Asia and Europe, operating from offices in Kolkata, Bangalore, and Birmingham (UK). The organization connects four key business areas: digital media and marketing, edTech, IT\-enabled services, mobile app and web app development. Over the past 20 years, the company has grown through future\-focused thinking, strategic execution, and wise investment in technology and talent. Mind \& Matter showcases all its businesses under one umbrella brand, emphasizing global capabilities, local focus, and a unified culture. Applicants can explore individual business lines via their LinkedIn company pages to understand the breadth of services and opportunities.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Business Analyst (Customer Solution \& Requirements), you will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will lead customer discovery sessions to uncover operational challenges, translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, and ensure delivered software solutions align directly with customer goals while minimizing scope creep and rework.
 



  





**Role Outcomes** 



* Client onboarding transitions smoothly from signed contract into discovery, scope baselines, and implementation roadmaps.
* Drive and ownership of Client business goals being accurately translated into structured BRDs, FRDs, and SRS documents that drive the end\-to\-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Engineering, UI/UX, and QA teams receive production\-ready user stories, system workflows, business logic, and acceptance criteria across all development sprints.
* Scope creep and requirement churn are proactively controlled through formal change management and continuous client communication.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) achieves fast, structured sign\-offs with direct traceability to the agreed functional specifications.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Discovery \& Client Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead post\-sales requirement workshops, discovery, kickoff sessions, and recurring discovery meetings with client\-side product owners, department heads, and end users.
* Uncover operational challenges, target workflows, and critical success factors; translate contractual scope into realistic functional deliverables.
* Capture detailed meeting minutes, decisions, system dependencies, assumptions, and risk items, obtaining formal client sign\-off.
* Serve as the primary post\-sales functional liaison between the client and internal technical delivery teams.



**Requirement Engineering (BRD, FRD, SRS \& Process Modeling)** 



* Create end\-to\-end
 **Business Requirements Documents (BRD)** 
 detailing business objectives, high\-level scope, user roles, and operational constraints.
* Formulate exhaustive
 **Functional Requirements Documents (FRD)** 
 specifying UI behavior, validations, error handling, system logic, and data structures.
* Develop and maintain
 **Software Requirements Specifications (SRS)** 
 inputs, covering non\-functional requirements, external interfaces, and system interaction constraints.
* Map current client operations (As\-Is) to proposed platform capabilities (To\-Be) using diagrams, process models, and data flow diagrams.
* Maintain a live
 **Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)** 
 linking each business objective through FRD/SRS specifications, sprint backlog items, test cases, and deployment.



**Sprint Execution \& Software Life Cycle (SDLC) Enablement** 



* Own functional grooming throughout the Agile/Scrum delivery lifecycle, breaking down FRDs and SRS items into well\-structured user stories with clear Given\-When\-Then acceptance criteria.
* Drive the Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Reviews to ensure engineering and QA teams understand functional nuances before development begins.
* Provide continuous, in\-sprint functional support to resolve blockers, clarify ambiguous edge cases, and validate work\-in\-progress features.
* Enforce change request procedures by evaluating the scope, cost, sprint velocity, and schedule impact of new client feature requests.



**User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Go\-Live \& Handover** 



* Formulate UAT plans, test scenarios, and acceptance checklists aligned with the signed FRD/SRS.
* Coordinate UAT execution directly with client business users, triaging reported defects to distinguish genuine functional bugs from new out\-of\-scope change requests.
* Guide clients through release demos, product walkthroughs, and end\-user enablement sessions to secure formal project sign\-off.
* Support post\-launch rollout, deployment and functional knowledge transfer to the ongoing client support team.



  





**Expected Deliverables** 



* Client Discovery Agenda, Stakeholder Map, and Meeting Action Logs
* As\-Is \& To\-Be Process Flowcharts and Data Flow Diagrams
* Business Requirements Document (BRD)
* Functional Requirements Document (FRD)
* Software Requirements Specification (SRS) inputs
* Sprint\-Ready User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Edge\-Case Matrices
* Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)
* Change Request Logs with Scope and Timeline Impact Assessments
* UAT Test Scripts, Defect Logs, and Client Acceptance Sign\-Off Records



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* **1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or Solution Analyst in a post\-sales, software solution development or SaaS implementation environment.**
* Hands\-on experience drafting formal
 **BRD, FRD, and SRS** 
 documentation, as well as managing sprint backlogs in Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Solid understanding of the complete
 **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)** 
 and Agile/Scrum execution practices.
* Proven track record of independently facilitating workshops and managing client expectations across multiple post\-sales engagements.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and stakeholder presentation skills.

title: SAP EHS-Senior
description:

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant specializing in
 **SAP EHSM (Environment, Health \& Safety Management)** 
 within the S/4HANA framework. This role focuses on modern safety processes such as Incident Management, Risk Assessment, Workplace Safety, Management of Change (MoC), and Safety Observations. You will work with advanced EHS capabilities including AI\-driven safety instructions, risk analytics, and modular EHS components.
   

  

 You will participate in requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, documentation, and deployment of SAP Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) and Safety Management (EHSM) modules, ensuring high\-quality delivery in line with EY standards.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Consultant, you will take ownership of key deliverables within workstreams and support client engagements across the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Project \& Delivery Responsibilities**
* Support end\-to\-end delivery of SAP EHS/EHSM workstreams including requirements gathering, blueprinting, design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Conduct functional workshops with business stakeholders to understand EHS processes, compliance needs, and risk management requirements.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and system configurations.
* Assist in designing SAP EHS/EHSM solutions across modules such as:
+ Product Safety \& Compliance (PS)
+ Industrial Hygiene \& Safety (IH\&S)
+ Occupational Health
+ Incident/Accident Management
+ Risk Assessment \& Controls
+ Environment Management
+ Management of Change (MoC)

* Collaborate with technical teams for WRICEF development and integrations with SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Execute unit testing, system integration testing, UAT support, and deployment readiness.
* Create and maintain project documentation including PDDs, BPPs, configuration guides, and test scripts.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Work directly with client users, super\-users, and business SMEs for issue resolution and requirement clarifications.
* Support client training sessions and user enablement during deployment.


**Support \& Enhancements**
* Provide SAP EHS/EHSM application support, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvements.
* Analyze system gaps, propose optimized solutions, and ensure alignment with S/4HANA best practices.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to address complex functional requirements.
* Ability to work independently on assigned deliverables and collaborate effectively in a hybrid (onshore–offshore) team.
* Clear communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage directly with clients.
* Strong documentation discipline and adherence to project governance standards.
* Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and work under minimal supervision.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Hands\-on configuration experience in SAP EHS/EHSM components:
* Hazardous Substance Management
* Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Management
* Dangerous Goods Management
* Incident/Accident Reporting
* Risk Assessments, Controls \& Mitigation
* Good understanding of regulatory compliance standards (OSHA, REACH, GHS, ISO 45001, etc.)
* Knowledge of SAP EHS master data and integration with:
* SAP MM / PP / QM / PM
* SAP Environment, Health \& Safety Management (EHSM) submodules
* Experience in S/4HANA EHS architecture and Fiori applications.
* Experience in preparing functional specifications for enhancements, reports, workflows, and interfaces.
* Exposure to SAP EHS mobile applications or third\-party EHS tool integration is an added advantage.


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) Preferably Engineering
* 4–6 years of SAP EHSM / Workplace Safety experience.
* At least one complete EHS/EHSM implementation plus support/enhancement experience.


**What We Offer You**

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
